scope: Three bounded demonstrations, a cross-member source trace sample, observed dependence groups and a source-grounded AI pilot. Not a critical edition or external academic validation.

selection.source_trace: For each of 18 members, rank every retrievable collection/ID pair by SHA256 of source-trace-v1|repository|collection|id. Select the lowest three. Views may overlap; no physical-population error estimate is licensed.
demonstrations: Recompute exact Milyan cache equality and Cypriot source-ID overlap
Recompute the U008 locus conflict from literal KH 8 attestation slots
Inspect the full encoded CH reading and CM occurrence views for positional-unit comparability
selection.prior_exposure: Development team has inspected the historical audits and chosen demonstrations because they expose known issues. These are replication/feasibility demonstrations, not blind discoveries. Hash-ranked trace sampling is a bounded diagnostic, not an independent scholarly accuracy sample.

source_check_levels.byte_trace: Recompute file hash and resolve the exact native pointer independently of the native dossier; require identical payload.
source_check_levels.citation_candidates: Extract explicit attribution and locator fields with original field pointers. Presence does not verify citation correctness or primary consultation.
source_check_levels.primary_edition_check: Only report a fresh primary-edition check if the original edition was actually inspected in this study. Otherwise NOT_PERFORMED.
source_check_levels.external_review: Requires a separately attributable qualified reviewer. No agent pass or prepared form qualifies.

dependence_policy: Exact shared bytes or documented edition IDs establish source-view dependence only. Do not infer physical-object joins, independent witnesses, or sum heterogeneous units. Different bytes and absent tested joins do not establish independence.

ai_evaluation.design: Frozen source-grounded development pilot with public tasks, separately sealed expected structured outcomes and hash commitments made before model responses. Hold oracle and scorer out of response-agent context.
ai_evaluation.grading: Deterministic structured-field comparison plus a disclosed non-blinded semantic review. No lexical keyword score may be called a hallucination rate.
ai_evaluation.baseline: Direct extraction baseline on factual fields only; no invented human/manual timings. Abstention and interpretation tasks have no equivalent direct-extraction baseline.
ai_evaluation.limits: Same model family, no independent expert grader, task-author prior exposure, small selected task set and no cross-platform accuracy claim. A development pilot is not the independent academic evaluation requested by the audit.

rights: Publish original metadata, identifiers, hashes, source links and project-authored analysis. Native source content keeps component terms. Do not copy restricted full texts/images or override upstream terms.
acceptance: Replay outputs match frozen native revisions and source hashes
All source-trace failures remain visible and block completion
No unresolved scholarly gate is silently marked passed
Publish task errors as well as successes
